content.comment_body: Hello, when using a password-protected program, I am unable to access it from a laptop without the password. However, I can still alter the program using cursor keys. How can I prevent all access to the program? Thank you, [user_name] The controller is [product_name] ([article_no]) The operator display is [product_name] ([article_no])

Hi [user_name], You can try these steps: - Press ESC to enter the menu - Select OK to stop the [product_name], and confirm with Yes - Go to the Programme section, move down to Password, and set a password there.

Hi, thanks for your response. I followed your suggestion but the issue persists. To clarify, I have multiple [product_name] controllers, all with operator displays. I have read that password protection only works with certain software versions, and all my devices meet this requirement. Using a PC and [product_name] software, I enabled password protection. Despite this, when the operator uses the TD display's cursor controls, they can still access the program. My customer is asking me to switch to another mini PLC, but I cannot afford that. I am disappointed with the technical support I've received from [company_name], and my supplier has informed me that password protection may not work on my devices. Due to these issues, I have decided not to use [product_name] in future projects as support has been lacking. If anyone from [company_name] reads this, please help resolve this issue.

Hi [user_name], you cannot change the actual program from the TD display—only parameters can be adjusted. If you want to prevent the operator from modifying a parameter, enable 'protection active' in the relevant function block. For example, if an on-delay timer is used, operators can change the time from the TD unless the 'protection active' option is enabled. If it is checked, operators cannot view or modify this parameter from the display.
Thanks [user_name], I'm planning to test the next panel soon and will try your suggestion. Thank you, [user_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering problems with the password protection feature for [product_name] controllers when used alongside the TD operator device. Despite enabling password protection via [product_name] software, unauthorized parameter changes are still possible through the display's interface. There is confusion over the level of security provided and dissatisfaction with available technical support and guidance.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks comprehensive password protection that can fully block any unauthorized access or changes to programming and parameters, both through PC and TD device interfaces.
